subject: HTML script tag for server output

messages.author: 4a7a7527ee4c2688
messages.subject: HTML script tag for server output
parts:
Hi all,

In server.R,
output$id<-renderText({input$xx})

If I want to do the following in ui.R
tags$script(src = output$id)

what should I do?

I tried the following and didn't work.

 HTML(paste("<script src='", "<span id='id' class='shiny-text-output'></span>", "'></script>", sep=""))


Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: HTML script tag for server output
parts: You can't ever "read" output$id--it's not a place to store values. Instead, create a uiOutput/renderUI whose render expression is tags$script(src = input$xx).
